blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of Cebu (UC) Baby Webmasters survived a thrilling overtime battle against the University of the Visayas (UV) Baby Lancers, pulling off a 76-67 victory in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (CESAFI) Season 26 high school basketball tournament on Monday, October 5, at the Cebu Coliseum. The win improved UC’s record to 6-1, keeping the Baby Webmasters atop the standings, while UV slipped to 2-3. Mark Jovil Datoon emerged as UC’s hero after drilling a game-tying three-pointer at the buzzer to force overtime with the game knotted at 61-all. READ: Cesafi: UV romps past UCLM […]...
